title: Contractor Blames Recent Repairs for Damage to National Mall's Reflecting Pool
snippet: A contractor report indicates that damage to Washington's iconic Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool was caused by recent restoration work rather than natural wear and tear.
content:
WASHINGTON — Damage to the iconic Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool was the direct result of recent maintenance work, according to a contractor's assessment detailed in a report by The New York Times.

Unintended Consequences of Restoration

The structural issues and leaks that recently compromised the landmark's water system stemmed from the very repair efforts meant to preserve it. According to the contractor, specific equipment and construction techniques used during the routine overhaul unexpectedly damaged the pool's underlying integrity.

National Park Service officials are currently evaluating the assessment as engineering teams work to mitigate further damage and outline a timeline for full repairs to the beloved National Mall destination.
